The legal issues presented in the paragraph involve a challenge to a local government regulation imposing fishing quotas. The core legal questions are whether the regulation infringes upon the fishing companies' rights to conduct business (potentially raising issues of due process, takings, or protected economic liberties) and whether the local government possesses the legal authority to enforce such measures (raising questions of preemption, statutory authority, or constitutional limits on local power).

Regarding the priority question: A typical year has 365 days.
